body:
Part of the Backlog-off-the-board change (see **Workflow: Backlog off the board**, 35564bb525e93b96). Once Backlog is hidden from the board, an active feature's tasks have to be in Planning to show up there.

- When a feature becomes `active` (by a human edit or an approved proposal), its tasks in `backlog` move to `planning`. Each move adds a solace note naming the feature.
- A feature's Tech Debt task (D-112) is filed in `planning`, not `backlog`. This amends D-112.
- A task created or linked to a feature that is already `active` goes in `planning` too.
- Rust in `tasks.rs`/`board.rs`. Update Spec 15 and the tests in `board_tests.rs` and `board_acceptance.py` that expect Tech Debt in `backlog`.
title: Active feature plans its tasks
